QA-29278 is **FAIL** on A1; A2 passes. I ran the Monday HBO Max / HBO Max pair, TikTok only, Impressions data set, Oct. 18–24, 2026.

- **A1 (Total Impressions shows a value on every post): FAIL.** 67 of 126 TikTok posts show "–". The other 59 show numbers that sum to 46,411,992, matching the aggregate row. All 67 have Engagements 0 and Reach "–". Rank 76 also has 0 engagements but shows Impressions 4,280, so zero engagement doesn't explain it. No known bug matched, and no TikTok collection banner was showing.
- **A2 (Organic and Paid Impressions are en-dash): PASS.** All 126 posts and the aggregate row show "–" for both.
- **Not run:** Amazon Prime Video and Conde Nast / Vogue-US from the same Monday row. The 2026-10-20 run on UCLA used only the first pair too and passed, so the failure looks specific to HBO Max's TikTok data.
- **Skills:** skill and registry updates are left for harvest.sh, as instructed.

The report is `results/2026-10-26/QA-29278-report.md`, with screenshots in `.playwright-out/QA-29278/`.
